independently_verified.scope: Optional process-identity observations and explicit namespace-local PID field names only; no argv, cwd, subprocess launch, wait, resource-control, or proof-acceptance change.

limits: Read-only static review; no process launched and no real proc traversal or integration fixture duplication.
Inherited output-parent fsync, postlaunch exception, in-memory final log and platform-survival limitations are accurately documented.
No proof, compiler, checker, source-build, or release acceptance is inferred.
review_notes: The stat parser isolates comm using its first opening and final closing delimiter, then indexes PPid and starttime at the documented stat offsets; it does not split a potentially spaced comm field.

A child is associated with a mounted proc entry only after unique PPid, NSpid depth/local PID, namespace identity, stat/status consistency and stable repeated stat checks. Absence, ambiguity, races and access failures produce UNAVAILABLE, not guessed host IDs.
Recorded host identity is an observation, not a guarantee the child remains alive; Popen.wait remains authoritative for the actual process return.
Original supervisor and existing build evidence remain untouched. Any consumer of old pid field names must use the revision02 explicit field names; README makes this format change clear.
